pages.title: Give Thanks for the Harvest
pages.child_instruction: Color the family bringing a harvest wagon to say thank You to God.
pages.bible_connection: The harvest picture helps us practice giving thanks because the Lord is good.
pages.visual_prompt: Integrated black line-art coloring scene: family with a harvest wagon of wheat and corn, a barn, a thankful child with a small hymn book, pumpkins nearby but not copied from Mission 1's church festival. No letters in the artwork.

pages.title: Find the Thank-You Harvest
pages.child_instruction: Find and circle all 8 thank-you harvest items. Each one can help you remember that God is good.
pages.bible_connection: Looking for each gift is practice for giving thanks, as Psalm 107:1 teaches.
pages.visual_prompt: Controlled barn-yard background without the eight targets. Independently placed wheat sheaf, corn cob, loaf, pitcher, pie, hymn book, heart, and thank-you card.

pages.title: Carry the Thank-You Basket
pages.child_instruction: Start at the child with the basket. Follow the path to the barn table.
pages.bible_connection: Carrying the basket to the table is a picture of bringing our thanks to God.
pages.visual_prompt: One farmyard scene: child with a thank-you basket at START, unique corn-row maze, barn table with a simple meal at FINISH. Not a maze pasted on a blank page.

pages.title: What Can You Thank God For?
pages.child_instruction: Check three ways you can give thanks. Then draw one thing you are thankful for.
pages.bible_connection: Giving thanks because God is good is what Psalm 107:1 teaches.
pages.visual_prompt: One wheat-framed page: four illustrated choices, a large basket drawing area, and a short prayer ribbon.
pages.drawing_prompt: Draw one thing you thank God for today
pages.prayer: Lord, You are good. Thank You for Your never-ending kindness.
